content.text: Recently, the government confirmed a £200 million project that will connect the M6 at Laney Green in Staffordshire to the M54 at Featherstone, close to Wolverhampton.
Recently, the £200m project linking the M6 at Laney Green, Staffordshire, to the M54 at Featherstone, close to Wolverhampton, was confirmed by the government.
